Class OverloadRules

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.generator.OverloadRules
@Internal public final class OverloadRules extends Object
Which method an invocation names. The bytecode binds the one of the model by its descriptor; a source language selects the most specific one that takes the values as the source types them, so a value is cast to the parameter of the model wherever another overload would take it - and to the type the receiver binds a variable of its class with.
Since:
2.3

    • lexicalErasure

      public static TypeDef lexicalErasure(TypeDef sourceType, @Nullable ObjectDef objectDef, @Nullable MethodDef method)
      The erasure a compiler selects an overload by for a variable named alone: that of the bound the method or the class declares it with. The model resolves a call by name without that bound, taking the variable as an Object, so a value of a T extends Number is cast to the Object of the model where another overload takes a Number - as the bytecode writers call it.
      Parameters:
      sourceType - The type of the value in the source
      objectDef - The definition the call is written in, or null
      method - The method the call is written in, or null
      Returns:
      The erased bound of a variable named alone, or of an array of one, else the type as it is
